title: paraboea glabra

It is a small, herbaceous plant that has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Paraboea glabra include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
